note: Strummed rock and pop additions towards ~100 songs (28 Oct 2026), from docs/STRUMALONG_SONG_RESEARCH.md (v4 batch). Each entry carries genre (rock or pop). Capo, setup and skill notes are authored suggestions from chord sheets; practice patterns come from the level defaults. Not checked against the recordings beyond the automatic chart sanity check. Fallbacks only: not imported, not read by the exporter.

songs.title: Hey Jealousy
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 2 suggested: play C, D, Em and G shapes; they sound as D, E, F#m and A.
songs.skill_focus: A jangly electric strum on capo-2 shapes.

songs.title: Story of My Life
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 3 suggested: play Am, F, C and G shapes; they sound as Cm, Ab, Eb and Bb.
songs.skill_focus: A four-chord loop with F, picked in the verses and strummed in the choruses.

songs.title: Naive
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 4 suggested: play Em, C, G, D and D/F# shapes; they sound as G#m, E, B, F# and F#/A#.
songs.skill_focus: Staccato muted chords in the verse and a strummed chorus.

songs.title: Kathleen
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 7 suggested: play G, Em, Am, D and C shapes; they sound as D, Bm, Em, A and G.
songs.skill_focus: A fast electric strum on capo-7 shapes.

songs.title: Wake Up Little Susie
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open D, F, G and A shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A chordal D-F-G-F strum figure and a steady acoustic strum. Watch the stop bars.

songs.title: Don't Dream It's Over
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 1 suggested: play D, Bm, G, A and Em shapes; they sound as Eb, Cm, Ab, Bb and Fm.
songs.skill_focus: A strummed acoustic part under organ.

sources.title: Ultimate Guitar Don't Dream It's Over chords

songs.title: Banana Pancakes
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open G, Am, D7, C7, Bm and Em shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A syncopated strum with seventh chords.

songs.title: Movin' on Up
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 5 suggested: play G, D, C and Am shapes; they sound as C, G, F and Dm.
songs.skill_focus: A Stones-style acoustic strum with gospel piano and choir.

sources.title: Ultimate Guitar Movin' on Up chords

songs.title: The Day We Caught the Train
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open Em, D, G, C, A and B shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A strummed Britpop part with many chord colours and lead lines.

sources.title: e-chords: The Day We Caught the Train
SongBPM: The Day We Caught the Train

songs.title: When I Come Around
songs.setup_note: Tune down a half step (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb) to match the record, no capo: play G, D, Em and C shapes. In standard tuning the record sounds as F#, C#, D#m and B (capo 6 gives C, G, Am, F shapes, L4).
songs.skill_focus: Palm-muted chord strumming on G, D, Em and C; the record is tuned down a half step.

sources.title: Andy Guitar: When I Come Around
